question: Who are identified as the independent impellers of the family across the four ages?
premises: The four ages are invoked as a designation.
The lord of gods is addressed.
Independent impellers of the family are named.
inference: The independent impellers of the family are identified in relation to the four ages.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of caturyuga iti is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: Thus, O lord of gods, they are the independent impellers of the family through the four ages.
